summary: World (setting/region) CMS API helpers. formatWorld parses each item's sExt JSON and maps world-name, world-name-en, world-slide[0].url (cover), world-banner, world-banner-m, world-home-banner[0].url and sTitle/sIntro/iInfoId onto name, nameEN, cover, banner, bannerM, homeBanner, title, summary and id. getList and getWorldList call the user-model get (module 1117) on appBundle.apiBase + "/getContentList" (channel CHANNEL_ID_CONFIG.WORLD, sLangKey "zh-cn", page size 20/10), and getDetail calls "/getContent" with iAround: 1, returning the formatted item with sContent as content.

exports.a: world CMS API object { formatWorld, getList, getWorldList, getDetail }
